ticks.note: `start`: in both charts the client emits `req` and enters `Waiting`, and the server answers with `ack` in the same tick. `SameTick`'s immediate transition sees it and counts the job. `SameTickDelayed`'s `Waiting` was entered in this tick, so its delayed transition is not checked yet.
It waits for an acknowledgement that will never come.
`start` again: `SameTick` serves it in this tick (`served` is 2). `SameTickDelayed` ignores it: its client is not in `Idle`.
